summary: PVT characterization report for sky130-opamp (two-stage Miller-compensated op-amp, DR-007 sizing): aggregated worst-corner tables over 5 process corners (tt/ff/ss/sf/fs) x 3 temperatures (-40/27/125 C). The cited record 20261009-103006-566b9a5.md covers the ICMR and CMRR benches (issue #53; 45 klt-sim batch-fleet units, 0 failed, runner klt 0.5.0 vs client 0.7.0) and carries the six earlier rows forward by reference to the unchanged 20261001-074923-c317ff9 record (ngspice, 45 runs, 0 failed). COVERAGE IS PARTIAL, AND klt signoff DOES NOT GRADE COVERAGE -- it grades this envelope's status field alone. This status therefore asserts only that the report exists, aggregates the measurements this block has in this envelope, is current for the committed netlist (design/netlist/opamp_core.spice), and states honestly what it did and did not measure. It asserts NOTHING about spec compliance: that is T1 item 5, which is uncited and unmet. Of spec/target-spec.md section 2's 12 performance rows, 8 ARE CHARACTERIZED here -- open-loop DC gain, GBW, phase margin, slew rate (rise and fall), output swing, quiescent power, input common-mode range (ICMR) and CMRR -- and 4 ARE UNCHARACTERIZED in this envelope: input-referred noise (bench verified in issue #54 but the PVT grid is not recorded), input-referred offset (TBD; needs a mismatch Monte Carlo pass, none run), PSRR (benched with a full 15-corner batch record under issue #54, in its own record 20261009-073254-e06f2fc, which this envelope does not aggregate), and area (TBD; layout/ holds only a placeholder). Two of the characterized rows measure below target at their binding corner and are recorded as such, not laundered by this pass status: slew rate on the FALLING edge, 11.03 V/us at SS/-40 C = 55% of the ~20 V/us target, and output swing, 0.948 Vpp at SS/-40 C against the ~1.39 Vpp DR-002 estimate = 68%. ICMR (criterion: local DC CMRR >= 40 dB with the output held at mid-rail; a CMRR-degradation range, not a device-saturation one): the ratified target window 0.888-1.024 V is covered at all 15 grid points (highest low edge 0.7388 V at FS/-40 C, lowest high edge 1.1686 V at SS/-40 C), but the bandgap-amp consumer sense point of 0.73 V is NOT covered at FS/-40 C (low edge 0.7388 V); no target was relaxed. CMRR (Adm - Acm from the same deck; spec row is TBD so ungraded): worst 55.11 dB at 1 Hz and 1 kHz at SS/-40 C with mid-rail common mode, 69.34 dB at the 0.956 V target-window centre (FS/125 C). The other four earlier rows meet their targets at every one of 15 grid points (see the 20261001-074923-c317ff9 record). FRESHNESS CAVEAT: klt signoff compares the manifest's pinned content_hash against this envelope's self-declared provenance.input.content_hash and never re-hashes the cited record on disk (klayout-tools#2196, #2403), so that gate is enforced repo-side by .github/workflows/signoff.yml's generic-envelope re-hash step, not by the grader.
